title: A 12TB Steam “teraleak” spills more than a decade of lost PC gaming history
summary: And while that list won’t contain the early versions of those games that stayed on developers’ local computers and office networks, the playtest versions that were often uploaded to Valve’s servers near release often still contain some interesting content.
